scope: Feasibility assessment only; no flash scan/erase/program, no RTL/PDS/board changes
schematic: ..\docs\盘古100Pro+开发板（MES2L676-100HP）配套资料\3_Hardware\原理图\MES2L676-CORE-V1.2原理图(100K).pdf
visual_review: Rendered schematic page3 and inspected two flash devices, shared SPI_CLK and FPGA CFG_CLK H13
config_clock: shared SPI_CLK -> dedicated CFG_CLK H13; ordinary soft SPI clock placement is not sufficient

candidate_cfgclk_primitive.pg2l100h_user_flash_access: UNPROVEN; requires official semantics review, isolated map and JEDEC read probe

five_group_packed_image_size: TBD: excludes bias, requant and headers
recommended_phases: validate board flash ID and configuration mode, preserve contents; persistent bitstream with cold power cycle
verify user-mode CFG_CLK access; SPI reader to buffered DDR loader, manifest/model-contract identity and CRC/readback, inference gate, UART recovery
model migration remains separate; optional A/B update and runtime flash erase/program later

estimate_engineering_time.persistent_bitstream: 0.5-1 working day if existing flash/tool path works
estimate_engineering_time.weights_autoload: 1-3 additional working days after user-mode flash access is proven, including integration/verification
estimate_engineering_time.if_access_fails: reassess vendor primitive/settings or separate 3.3V SPI flash module on verified free GPIO; no fixed completion promise

cpu_role: ROM firmware already included in bitstream; CPU supervises boot status/retry, bulk flash-to-DDR handled by small hardware loader; current CPU has no direct DDR access
previous_history_limit: cpu/docs/FLASH_BOOT.md belongs to historical design; pin values cannot be blindly applied to current 100H; supports caution, not proof of impossible user access
